One record covers the BICEP1, BICEP2/Keck Array and BICEP/Keck author groups because the official site (bicepkeck.org) presents them as one series; the BICEP1 papers are listed under "BICEP1 Papers" on the same site.

summary.plain: The team that has built and run the BICEP and Keck telescopes at the South Pole, searching the polarization of the Big Bang afterglow for the faint signal of gravitational waves from cosmic inflation.
summary.technical: BICEP/Keck Collaboration: the group behind BICEP1, BICEP2, the Keck Array, BICEP3 and BICEP Array; publishes as "BICEP2", "BICEP2/Keck Array" and "BICEP/Keck" on the official site.
